title: Wait for async work
summary: Async work finishes later. A test must wait for its promise before checking the result.
introduction: Async work finishes later. A test must wait for its promise before checking the result. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Async work finishes later. A test must wait for its promise before checking the result.

blocks.code:
async function getScore() { return 8; }
getScore().then(score => console.log(score === 8));
blocks.title: Wait for async work

blocks.text: The check prints true after the promise resolves. In a test runner, return or await the promise.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Change the returned score and its expected value.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A test can finish too early if you forget to wait.
For more detail later, use this [Unit Testing further reading](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html).
